chunks: Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to us, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Salih ibn Sahl, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad,

regarding His Exalted Saying: 'Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], 'Announce to your people before there comes to them a painful punishment.' [1] He said: Its interpretation is regarding a punishment that occurs in Ath-Thawiyya (meaning fire), until it reaches the dunghill, the dunghill of Banu Asad, until it passes by Thaqif. It will not leave a remnant of the Family of Muhammad except that it burns it, and that is before the emergence of the Qa'im.'

key_terms.آل محمد: The Family of Muhammad, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt.
key_terms.الثَّوِيَّة: A region in Mecca, often associated with a specific location of fire or disaster in eschatological narrations.
key_terms.القائم: The Rising One, a title for the Twelfth Imam, Muhammad al-Mahdi, who will rise to establish justice.
key_terms.الكناسة: Dunghill or refuse heap, used metaphorically here to denote a place of accumulation or destruction.
key_terms.تأويل: Interpretation or esoteric meaning of a Quranic verse.

ai.seo_question: What is the interpretation of the 'painful punishment' in the verse about Noah in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (as) interprets the divine command to Noah as a prophetic sign of a specific fire erupting in Ath-Thawiyya, which will spread through the tribes of Asad and Thaqif. This fire serves as a purifying trial that consumes the remnants of the Ahl al-Bayt before the emergence of the Mahdi (al-Qa'im), highlighting the historical continuity of divine warnings in Shia eschatology.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (48) Muhammad bin Hammam narrated from Ja’far bin Muhammad bin Malik from Muhammad bin al-Husayn bin Abul Khattab from al-Hasan bin Ali from Salih bin Sahl that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as)

had said when talking about the verse, ‘A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall:’ “It is not a questioner asked….it is a flowing that flowed and it is a fire that will flame in ath-Thawiyya and then it will move to the tribe of Asad and then to the tribe of Thaqeef. It will burn the enemies of Muhammad’s progeny. This will be before the appearance of al-Qa’im (as).”
